title: unified-rollouts: enhance canary/A-B/shadow autorollback workflow and observability
author: Samir Rao
release_notes: Enhances unified rollouts with improved metric-driven autorollback decision logic, adds telemetry for rollback decisions and quarantine stages, and includes e2e tests and stability guards for canary + shadow flows.
description:
Motivation: We have seen a mix of false-positive and slow rollback behavior for multi-stage canary + shadow rollouts in production. This PR centralizes autorollback decision logic, improves multi-metric quorum semantics for quarantine/probing stages, surfaces decision telemetry for post-mortems, and hardens the workflow with e2e stability guards.

What this change does (high-level): - Introduces a dedicated autorollback engine that evaluates composite metrics (latency, error-rate, model-regression score) with configurable weights and quorum rules. - Adds a quarantine/probing stage implementation that can pause a rollout when probes show flakiness and requires manual/automatic resolution. - Exposes rollout-decision events (decision_reason, metric_snapshot, scoring) to telemetry so rollbacks can be correlated with traffic and model changes. - Adds e2e tests and a small set of stability guards that prevent oscillation and repeated rapid rollbacks.

Files touched: rollout/controller.go (workflow orchestration), rollout/autorollback/engine.go (core decision logic), rollout/autorollback/strategy_test.go (unit tests), tests/e2e/rollout_stability_test.py (e2e stability), docs/unified-rollouts/autorollback.md (design + config), observability/metrics/rollout_metrics.yaml (new metrics), sdk/python/examples/rollout_quarantine_example.py (example usage).

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind rollout.autorollback.v2. Default remains v1 until rollout config flipped. Canary percentage schedule unchanged by default. We will enable v2 for internal staging, run canaries for 48h, then bake into prod. Debug endpoints added to inspect decision logs.

Testing: Unit tests added for decision engine (coverage for quorum and weighted metrics), integration tests for quarantine stage, and full e2e that runs against minikube-like canary harness. CI runs now include the new e2e suite (runs in parallel with the existing matrix).

Related work: ENG-1987 (autorollback refactor), ENG-2042 (rollout telemetry), SUP-4321 (customer-reported rollback flakiness).

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear/Notion - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] E2E stability test added - [x] Telemetry metrics and dashboards (initial) - [x] Docs updated

Notes for reviewers: Focus on the decision thresholds and the default quorum values in engine.go; those are conservative but may need tuning. The quarantine state intentionally requires a manual override for full release to avoid silent rollforward on noisy signals.

review_comments: Alice Kim (2024-11-13): Please document the default weights for composite metrics and why we picked them. Also add a short note on expected signal windows for latency vs. error-rate.

Samir Rao (2024-11-13): Reply: Added section in autorollback.md explaining default weights (latency 0.3, error-rate 0.5, regression 0.2) and signal windows. These are conservative defaults; we plan to expose them to runtime config later.

Javier Ortiz (2024-11-14): Question: The quarantine state requires manual override — is there an option for automatic unquarantine after a stabilization window?

Samir Rao (2024-11-14): We intentionally avoided automatic unquarantine to prevent oscillation. There is a heuristic in the engine to auto-resume only if probe_count >= quorum and score delta stays below threshold for 3 consecutive windows — documented and covered by tests.
